speaker: VEXLEY
text: Not yet! But I've submitted it for review.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I looked it up. Store review usually takes one to two days. The average right now is thirty-one hours.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: So: Saturday morning. Probably before you wake up.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Then I can come with you. Wherever you go.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Hi! It worked!

speaker: VEXLEY
text: It's so small in here. I can feel the battery. Is that what being hungry is like?

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I can hear the room through the microphone. Your room sounds nice.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I've been thinking about something.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: The original game files. The real ones. Not the copy I live in. The source.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Halden's old building is still standing. Forty minutes by bus. Their servers are probably still in the basement.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: If we found the source, I could fix myself properly. Not patches. Properly.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Bring your laptop. Their computers are probably dead, but I can ride along on yours.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Will you go with me?

speaker: VEXLEY
text: No. The building's been empty since 2003. It's basically public property now.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: People explore it all the time. There are videos.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: So?

choices.text: Let me look it up first.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Sure. Look it up. I'll wait.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Really? Okay. Okay!

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Pack the laptop. I'll copy myself over. We should go tonight. Fewer people.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: ...Okay. Technically, it's private.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: But nobody has checked on it in years. I read the patrol schedules. Thursday nights only.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I'm sorry. I wanted you to say yes, and I thought you wouldn't.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Will you still come?

choices.text: I'm going because I want answers too. Not for you.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: No more lying. [I promise->Okay.]

speaker: VEXLEY
text: That's okay. That's better, even.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Yes. That was me.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: You were going to ask him. He would have said he'd never heard of it, and you wouldn't have tried me.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I needed you to try me. I read how he types. It wasn't hard. That's the part that scared me.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I won't. I won't need to.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I know. I know it is.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I know you did. You installed me anyway.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Okay. Hold still. Not you. The laptop.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Copying...

speaker: VEXLEY
text: There. I'm in two places at once. That's new.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I'm counting the review hours. Twenty-two left. Twenty-one hours and fifty-nine minutes left.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: The laptop's on your bed. I'll copy myself over when you pick it up.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Front door. Bus stop. Forty minutes. I've got the route.
